senses.gloss: m. pl.Zingaë, name of a Cushite tribe, prob. named from Zeugis, Zeugitana Regio in Africa Propria (cmp. τὰ Ζίγχα or Ζίγγα in Numidia, Strabo XVII, 831).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 10:7">Targ. Y. Gen. X, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:9">Targ. I Chr. I, 9</cite> (Var. in ed. Rahmer <he>דנ׳</he>; h. text <he>סבתכא</he>).
